titles.title: No Desire for Streetcars Act
No Desire for Streetcars Act
To amend title 23 and title 49, United States Code, to prohibit funds from certain programs to be used to fund streetcars, and for other purposes.

action.text: Referred to the House Committee on Transportation and Infrastructure.
Referred to the Subcommittee on Highways and Transit.

bill.summary:
No Desire for Streetcars Act
This bill prohibits funds provided under certain Department of Transportation programs from being used for the procurement, operation, or maintenance of a streetcar.
Specifically, this prohibition applies to the
Surface Transportation Block Grant Program, Congestion Mitigation and Air Quality Improvement Program, Urbanized Area Formula Grants Program, andFixed Guideway Capital Investment Grants Program.
